name: clawyer-superengine
description: Runs a self-represented legal matter like a small law firm, in your own folder: guided setup that asks five plain questions, matter and evidence intake, a 15-reviewer council that checks every document from the other side or the court, a verification gate, and a premortem before anything goes out. Works for family, tax, and business or money disputes in any US state; its built-in doctrine was written for Mississippi family court and is labelled as an example everywhere else. Built on pro-se-firm v1.7.0 by Mic H. (MIT). Not a lawyer and not legal advice. Needs Claude Code Desktop; setup installs Python and the free document tools for you. 9 skills, 19 agents.
